content.value_statement: Teams need consistent React and React Native component structure. This skill guides typed components, styles, tests, Storybook stories, and accessibility setup.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes component requirements for name, type, props, state, hooks, styling, and platform.
Generates React component skeletons with TypeScript props, imports, state hooks, and effect hooks.
Creates React Native component templates with StyleSheet structure and accessibility labels.
Drafts test suites with Testing Library, Jest callbacks, and axe accessibility checks.
Produces CSS Modules, styled-components, Tailwind guidance, Storybook stories, and barrel exports.
limitations: Generated scaffolds still need local linting, testing, and visual review.
Placeholder parsing helpers require implementation in the target project.
It does not install dependencies or run build commands by itself.
Project-specific design system imports must be adapted by the user.

use_cases.title: Create Feature Components
use_cases.description: Generate a typed starting point for a new web component with props, styles, tests, and stories.

use_cases.title: Start Native UI Modules
use_cases.description: Draft React Native component structure with StyleSheet patterns and screen reader labels.

use_cases.title: Standardize Design System Output
use_cases.description: Apply repeatable component, test, and Storybook patterns across a shared component library.

prompt_templates.title: Scaffold a Basic Button
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to scaffold a web Button component named PrimaryButton. Include label, disabled, and onPress props, CSS Modules, tests, Storybook, and accessibility behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Native Card
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a React Native ProfileCard component. Include title, subtitle, avatarUrl, and onPress props with styles, tests, and accessibility labels.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Form Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to scaffold a typed SignupForm component. Include local state, validation states, submit callbacks, Tailwind styling, tests, and Storybook variants.

prompt_templates.title: Extend a Component Library
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add a universal FilterPanel component to a design system. Include web and native considerations, typed props, styling choices, accessibility checks, tests, stories, and exports.

output_examples.input: Create a typed web AlertBanner component with dismiss behavior and Storybook documentation.
output: A component file with typed props for title, message, tone, and dismissal handling.
A style file for the selected styling approach.
Tests for rendering, dismissal callbacks, and accessibility behavior.
Storybook stories for default, warning, success, and dismissible states.

output_examples.input: Generate a React Native SettingsRow component with a label, value, icon, and press handler.
output: A native component template using View, Text, TouchableOpacity, and StyleSheet patterns.
Typed props that map web-friendly names to React Native usage.
Accessibility labels and test guidance for the press interaction.

output_examples.input: Scaffold a design system Badge component with variants and documentation.
output: A reusable component outline with typed variant props.
Style guidance for CSS Modules, styled-components, or Tailwind.
Storybook examples that show common visual states.

best_practices: Provide the component name, platform, styling approach, props, and expected interactions upfront.
Define accessibility roles, labels, keyboard behavior, and screen reader states before generation.
Run generated tests locally and adapt imports to the project design system.
anti_patterns: Requesting a vague component without platform, props, styling, or behavior requirements.
Treating scaffolded output as production complete before linting, testing, and review.
Mixing web and native APIs without defining a clear universal abstraction.

faq.question: Does this skill support React Native?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes React Native component structure, StyleSheet examples, native type mapping, and accessibility labels.

faq.question: Can it generate TypeScript props?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on typed props, optional fields, descriptions, and reusable component interfaces.

faq.question: Does it create tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It drafts Testing Library tests, callback assertions, and axe accessibility checks for web components.

faq.question: Does it install dependencies?
faq.answer: No. It provides scaffolding guidance and generated files, but dependency installation remains a project task.

faq.question: Which styling systems are covered?
faq.answer: It covers CSS Modules, styled-components, and Tailwind-oriented class guidance.

faq.question: Is generated output ready to ship?
faq.answer: No. Review the output, run local tests, update project-specific imports, and validate accessibility before release.
